links.comparator_used: Other distribution shift detection techniques (classifier-based vs deep kernel vs multiple univariate Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests) on simulated population and acquisition shifts; no periodic labeled audit comparator
links.outcome: Detection rate of simulated distribution shifts (sex, ethnicity, co-morbidity, image quality) in retinal images
links.effect: Classifier-based tests performed best overall, with perfect detection rates for quality and co-morbidity subgroup shifts at a sample size of 1000. It was the only method to detect patient sex shifts. All methods identified easier-to-detect out-of-distribution shifts with small (≤300) sample sizes.
links.tradeoff: Classifier-based test required large sample sizes (>30,000) to detect patient sex shifts.
links.quote: Classifier-based tests performed best overall, with perfect detection rates for quality and co-morbidity subgroup shifts at a sample size of 1000.
